method: Native optical comparison at thresholds 165, 185 and 205, radius 12, blur 0.35, one retained component, no filled holes. One uniform cap scale and measured rigid rotation per row. Comparison paths can lose fine strokes and are not the selected font outlines. Equal contour counts alone do not establish completeness.

size_mapping.basis: The shared printed 6/7 heading is retained verbatim. Ordered sizes, native proportions and separately labelled document specimens support assigning the upper row to six point and the lower to seven point. Cap-height ratios agree across thresholds; the assignment does not rely on row order alone.

visual_exclusions: Comparison threshold 185 loses native fine strokes in many figures and selected capitals, especially six-point 1897 K/X/Q and thin document impressions. Contour counts alone cannot detect a missing arm or terminal. These comparison paths are not approved final outlines.
No inferred lowercase or punctuation. Every new cut requires complete native-to-outline review before promotion.
